senses.gloss:
स्थौर, अम्, n. (fr. स्थूर = स्थूल), firmness,
strength, power; a sufficient load for a horse or ass;
(अस्), m. a patronymic of the Vedic Ṛṣi Agni-
yuta or Agni-yūpa (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda
X. 116).

स्थौल, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, stout, robust (= स्थूल,
Ṛg-veda VI. 44, 7).

स्थौललक्ष्य, अम्, n. (fr. स्थूल-लक्ष),
the having great aims, munificence, liberality, (Manu
VII. 211.)

स्थौलशीर्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. स्थूल-शीर्ष),
having a large head or summit, large-headed.

स्थौलाष्ठीवि, इस्, m. (sometimes written स्थौ-
लष्ठीवि), N. of an ancient grammarian.

स्थौल्य, अम्, n. stoutness, bigness, largeness,
bulk, size, thickness, coarseness, grossness, denseness,
(opposed to सौक्ष्म्य); doltishness, density of
intellect.
स्थौणेयक, अम्, n. a kind of perfume.
